title: Practice 6: Actions and their results: nouns from verbs

blocks.text: Sentences and their English: Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR). Words, meanings and how each word is built: the English Wiktionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.why: **замеча́ние** — remark, observation, criticism. Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**замечание** — замеча́ние: remark, observation, criticism; reproof, rebuke, reprimand, talking-to, telling-off. Wiktionary: замеча́ть + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: созна́ние — consciousness (awareness); назва́ние — name, appellation, title; тре́бование — demand, request, claim (act of requesting); собра́ние — meeting, gathering.
**существова́ние** — existence, being. Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**существовании** — существова́ние: existence, being; subsistence. Wiktionary: существова́ть + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **созда́ние** — creation (act of creation). Source: Wiktionary, «-ание» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ание#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**создания** — созда́ние: creation (act of creation); creature. Wiktionary: созда́ть + -а́ние.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **уча́стие** — participation, collaboration, complicity. Source: Wiktionary, «-ие» (https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/-ие#Russian): the suffix's only meaning there.
**участие** — уча́стие: participation, collaboration, complicity; share, stake; sympathy, interest, concern. Wiktionary: участь + -ие.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **толчку** — толчок: push, impulse; (colloquial) toilet (fixture), toilet bowl; (colloquial) flea market. Wiktionary: толк + -ок.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: замеча́ние — remark, observation, criticism; существова́ние — existence, being; созда́ние — creation (act of creation); уча́стие — participation, collaboration, complicity.
**прыжки** — прыжок: jump, leap, bound; dive. Wiktionary: пры́гать + -о́к.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.

exercises.why: **тошнота** — (medicine) sickness, nausea (qualmishness; as, sickness of stomach). Source: Russian Wiktionary, «-от», meaning 2 (https://ru.wiktionary.org/wiki/-от).
**тошноту** — тошнота: (medicine) sickness, nausea (qualmishness; as, sickness of stomach); loathing. Wiktionary: то́шный + -ота́.
exercises.context: The English says which word it is.
